newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brokers take varying views on Thomson-CSF.
newsitem.headline: Brokers take varying views on Thomson-CSF.

text.p: Brokers took differing views on prospects for defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF following a Socialists-led election victory in France, fund managers said on Tuesday.
SGE Delahaye downgraded the stock to underperform from neutral, SBC Warburg upped it to buy from neutral, while NatWest Sellier went to accumulate from hold, they said.
Thomson-CSF was up 2.09 percent at 156.2 francs, on volume of 97,315 shares at 1121 GMT.
SGE Delahaye believes the Thomson-CSF privatisation will be cancelled and that the premium for minorities will disappear.
